+def _parse_version_info(version_string):
+    """
+    Parse a version string into a version_info tuple.
+    
+    Examples:
+        "3.4.0" -> (3, 4, 0)
+        "3.4.0.post1" -> (3, 4, 0, 'post', 1)
+        "3.4.0rc1" -> (3, 4, 0, 'rc', 1)
+    """
+    # Split on dots to get main version parts
+    # Handle versions like "3.4.0", "3.4.0.post1", "3.4.0rc1", etc.
+    
+    # First, extract the main version numbers (major.minor.micro)
+    match = re.match(r'^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)', version_string)
+    if not match:
+        # Fallback: try to parse what we can
+        parts = version_string.split('.')
+        try:
+            major = int(parts[0]) if len(parts) > 0 else 0
+            minor = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 0
+            micro = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0
+            return (major, minor, micro)
+        except (ValueError, IndexError):
+            return (0, 0, 0)
+    
+    major, minor, micro = int(match.group(1)), int(match.group(2)), int(match.group(3))
+    
+    # Check for pre-release/post-release identifiers
+    remainder = version_string[match.end():]
+    
+    if not remainder:
+        return (major, minor, micro)
+    
+    # Handle cases like ".post1", "rc1", "a1", "b1", etc.
+    # Look for patterns like ".post1", "rc1", "a1", "b1"
+    match = re.match(r'^\.?(post|rc|a|b|alpha|beta)(\d+)?', remainder)
+    if match:
+        release_type = match.group(1)
+        release_num = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) else 0
+        return (major, minor, micro, release_type, release_num)
+    
+    # If we can't parse the remainder, just return the main version
+    return (major, minor, micro)
+
